title: EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID ... CHANNEL (the next task of the conversation starts with the channel and its containers): ASSIGN CHANNEL and GET CONTAINER in the next task, a channel changed across turns, and RETURN CHANNEL below the highest logical level (INVREQ RESP2 2)

scenarios.summary: PC61 PUTs container STATE in channel PCCHAN and RETURNs TRANSID(PC62) CHANNEL(PCCHAN); the next ENTER starts PC62, whose current channel is PCCHAN and whose GET CONTAINER finds STATE
A channel changed across turns: PC62 replaces STATE, adds EXTRA and RETURNs its current channel again; the next turn reads both, deletes EXTRA and replaces STATE; the third turn sees the deletion
RETURN TRANSID CHANNEL in a LINKed program (not the highest logical level): INVREQ RESP2 2, and the program goes on
